reading.body:
This facility is unconfirmed. OpenStreetMap tags a location in Maricopa County as a data center under the name Accelera Data Systems, but the operator website could not be located and current business records at the coordinates show a different occupant. The name Accelera is used by multiple unrelated companies across industries, and Data Systems is generic enough that the tag alone does not establish this as a genuine AI infrastructure site. The research status for this entry is exhausted, meaning no published specifications exist in this site's database.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center locations, but only four have published power figures. This facility contributes no published megawatts to the 512 MW of confirmed state capacity that those four sites report. It ranks fifth by published MW in Arizona only because four other sites have disclosed specifications; that ranking reflects absence of data, not capacity.

A reader evaluating AI infrastructure capacity should not include this campus in forecasts or decisions. No power capacity, no operational operator, no certifications, and no confirmation that the facility is active distinguish it from a mapping error or a historical tag. The grid constraint on AI scaling in Arizona rests on the four sites that have published figures, not on unresolved entries like this one.
